component.name: HomePage2

Label.text: Click the following buttons for games!

component.script:
function init() m.top.setFocus(true)
m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.btnCheckers = m.top.findNode("btnCheckers") m.btnTic = m.top.findNode("btnTic") m.Stext = m.top.findNode("Stext")
' Font sizes if m.title <> invalid then m.title.font.size = 96 if m.hint <> invalid then m.hint.font.size = 24
' Make sure buttons are focusable and set initial focus to the left button if m.btnCheckers <> invalid then m.btnCheckers.focusable = true if m.btnTic <> invalid then m.btnTic.focusable = true if m.btnCheckers <> invalid then m.btnCheckers.setFocus(true) end function
' Handles the function of the keys pressed on the Roku remote function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press return false if key = "OK" or key = "Select" or key = "Enter" then if m.btnCheckers <> invalid and m.btnCheckers.isFocused() then ' User selected Checkers - replace this with navigation or event print "Checkers button pressed" return true end if if m.btnTic <> invalid and m.btnTic.isFocused() then print "Tic-Tac-Toe button pressed" return true end if end if return false end function
